note: TRAIM: if $9D11 = 1, SV count threshold from alarm $9D16 (<500/700/1000 -> 8/4/3/2), residuals $25B4[ch]/32.9, removes worst SV ($8FAF+SV = 0, $0A0BF2); outputs $9D28 alarm, $9D2A sigma ($FFFF invalid), $9D2C removed flag

name: traim_time_excl
note: (ch) mean of $657C+$174*ch over used channels ($1148[4*ch]=1) excluding ch, week rollover +-604800

note: no callers: $55/$AA write tests at EEPROM $11E0/$11E1 ...; returns $800 when all pass (as decoded)

note: looks up received 4 bytes in table $0A1FF2 ("@@Sa".."@@Sg","@@Tq")

name: terse_lookup
note: strcmp token against name table $0B0460 (BIN, NMEA, T, Z); returns index or $FF

name: terse_deg_min

name: terse_periodic
note: mode-2 periodic: rate $CB14, countdown $CB16; one report on fix gain ($CB29) and fix loss ($CB2A)

name: terse_rx_validate
note: scans line buffer $A9B2 for BIN/NMEA/T<n>/Z + CR LF; sets $CAF2 command index, $CAF4 value (T alone = 10000)

note: serial task: drains rx ring into line buffer $A9B2 (len $AA52, shift by 80 at 160) and history $AA54; on CR LF (or $DA in mode 3) rx_validate then rx_dispatch; pending @@Cd/@@Fd replies, @@Bd, self-test reply ($C65E/$C666 -> selftest(1), $0AAE96); then out flush ($0AE6AE)

name: fmt_long_bytes

name: nmea_cksum
note: XOR of string after first char (for "*%02X")

name: nmea_deg_min
note: radians -> degrees, minutes, 1/10000 minute (rounded, carries), hemisphere index

name: nmea_periodic
note: mode-1 periodic: 7 word rate/countdown pairs $CAF8+4n/$CAFA+4n; send when tx count < 376

name: msg_Ek
note: slot 20, out_len_E; body $0A9866(20, 8); bin_output_sched and cmd_E 'k'

name: reply_Ck
note: letters C k, empty payload, slot 10; after accepted @@Ce (cmd_C) and RTCM corrections ($0ABD9E, binary mode)

note: (slot, nch) nine x10 words ($7A10-$7A30, $81B2, $8F20-$8F30), correction age, three x100 longs ($8EEE-$8EFE), per-ch byte (chan +4), ten x10 words ($369C-$3714), clock bias x c, clock_drift

note: slot 16, out_len_C('l'); echoes @@Cl inputs $364C lat, $3654 lon, $3644 height, $365C date/time, $3674 offset, $366A mask, $366C, $3676-$3680; no direct callers

name: msg_Bg_Eg_body
note: (slot, nch) measurement time $81A6 (s 3 bytes + ns 4), per ch SV, state|flags, transmit time (s + ns) from ($8298-$8218)/-c, carrier $7048 (option C), $7044 (3), $7040 (2)

name: msg_Bn_En_body
note: (slot, nch) rate byte, TRAIM settings $9D0E-$9D2C (alarm $9D16/100), then per ch SV + 4-byte value

name: reply_Cg
note: letters C g, payload $C651 != 0; callers cmd_C ('g'), fix_mode_enter

name: msg_Bh_ch67
note: slot 22, letters B h, Ce-format; second corrections frame for channels 6-7 ($8248, $81E1, $7400, $7FC5) plus 4 empty entries; rate set by @@Bh

name: msg_Bd_eeprom
note: second half of @@Bd: almanac status of EEPROM bank $21024 ($20CA2/$20CA3, page flags $20C7C); caller msg_Bd

name: reply_selftest
note: (word) slot 10, 2-byte result: C letters -> & $3FFF, else bits rearranged; callers cmd_C 'a' (Ca), cmd_F (Fa), rx_task with selftest(1)

name: out_end
note: (slot, start) XOR checksum over len-5 bytes, CR LF

name: out_double
note: (slot, double, scale double, n) value*scale rounded via fmt_scaled ($0A6A40), n low bytes

name: out_long
note: (slot, long, n) n low bytes big-endian

name: out_begin
note: writes "@@" + letters $C5E2/$C5E3 into slot buffer via out_ptr[slot]; returns pointer to letters (checksum start)

name: rtcm_init
note: clears RTCM decoder state $CB2E, $CB34, $CBBC-$CBC0; caller io_init $0A5A22

name: rtcm_poll
note: $CB2C = 1 then rtcm_sync until -1; called each pass by rx_task

name: rtcm_getc
note: next byte $40-$7F from $AA54 via rtcm_byte_get, 6-bit bit-reversed through table $0B0936; $FF if none

name: rtcm_sync
note: word sync: preamble $66 (or inverted) + parity on two 30-bit words; header type $CBC3, station $CBC4, Z-count $CBC6, seq $CBC8, length $CBC9, health $CBCA

name: rtcm_get_word
note: assembles a 30-bit word from five 6-bit chars, D30* inversion, parity check; resumable via $CB2E

name: rtcm_frame
note: reads $CBC9 data words; type 1 -> rtcm_type1_unpack + rtcm_apply_corr

name: rtcm_hdr_parity
note: parity check of word with D29*/D30* = 0 then 2

name: rtcm_type1_unpack
note: type 1: (nwords x 3)/5 SV records (scale/UDRE, SV, PRC, RRC, IODE) -> 6-byte records at $CBCC

name: rtcm_apply_corr
note: Z-count x 0.6 s against gps_seconds; writes dgps_corr[$75C8 + 14 x SV] (valid, PRC, RRC, IODE, time); type 9 checks channel IODE; reply_Ck in binary mode; $81DA = 1

name: rtcm_apply_alt
note: no callers; same Z-count handling, writes 14-byte table at $77E2 + 14 x SV ($77DC, $77DE) (type 2 delta corrections, inferred)

name: rtcm_byte_get
note: reads $AA54[$B1D4] until $B1D6; resets both when empty

name: cb_almanac_store
note: @@Cb: copies 34 pages (type 4/5 page id via table $0B0976) of 8 x 3 bytes from $C667 into the almanac at ($81CA)

name: bf_ephem_store
note: @@Bf: 24 x 3 bytes of payload into $82D9 + SV x $50; flags $82D8, $8326

name: cmd_As
note: cmd_A case 's' (gated by options A, B or I): lat/lon (mas, +-90/180 deg), height cm (-1000..18000 m), type 0/1 -> $81F8, $8200, $81F0, $8209

name: m3_cksum
note: XOR of payload bytes (bit 7 clear) after the start byte, ^ $DA if terminator is $DA, else 0

name: m3_out_C6
note: builds the 23-byte $C6 frame into tx ring (see part-B.md)

name: m3_dispatch
note: mode-3 dispatch on line buffer first byte: $C6 -> mode3_rx_C6

name: m3_rx_validate
note: mode-3 frame scan: $C6 with $DA at +20 and checksum at +21; $CD "OTOROLA" $DA $9E poll

name: out_rates_clear
note: set_output_rate(n,0) for all 25 slots and eeprom_save_rate(n,0) for 8 (on ID-block checksum mismatch)

name: bin_out_flush
note: copies each slot buffer (out_rd $C57C+4n .. out_ptr) to tx ring while count < 750, fixed priority (Ez, Ba, Bk, Ea, ...), resets pointers; slot 10 via $0AE6C4

name: out_flush
note: mode 0: $0ADEF6 (slots -> TX ring), then tx_kick; called from $0A65D6

name: out_flush_reply_ring
note: moves whole frames from slot-10 ring $C12A-$C512 (rd $C5A4, bytes $C516) into TX ring while $A9B0 < 750; length from out_len

name: id_block_default
note: writes template "MODEL # XXX..." (options "IBC") to EEPROM $087B (140 B) and XOR checksum to $0905; called from $0A5A22

name: id_options_decode
note: reads OPTIONS LIST chars $08FB-$08FF: A -> $C654, I -> $C65C, B -> $C655, C/D/E -> $C656/$C657/$C658, F -> $C659, G -> $C65A/$8215; sets $820E = 1

name: out_len_B_tab
note: words: Ba 68, Bb 92, Bc 82, Bd 23, Bf 80, Bg 122, Bj 8, Bk 69, Bl 41, Bm 28, Bn 59, Bz 273

name: out_len_C_tab
note: words: Ca 9, Cb 33, Cc 80, Cd 171, Ce 52, Cf 7, Cg 8, Ch 9, Cj 294, Ck 7, Cl 43, Cm 12

name: out_len_E_tab
note: words: Ea 76, Ec 100, Eg 158, Ek 71, En 69, Ez 361
